description: This file contains JavaScript functions for creating and managing UI controls such as toggle switches, buttons, sliders, input fields, and modals, as well as a command console interface, specifically for a WebRTC client in a frontend web application.

methods.name: createToggleControl
methods.description: Creates a toggle switch UI control that calls a callback on toggle, updating its visual state accordingly.

methods.name: createButtonListener
methods.description: Attaches a click and mousedown listener to a button or set of buttons identified by ID or class.

methods.name: createSliderListener
methods.description: Binds input and change events to sliders of a specific class to update displayed values and trigger a listener.

methods.name: createInputListener
methods.description: Attaches input event listener to an input element identified by ID.

methods.name: createSelectListener
methods.description: Attaches change event listener to a select element identified by ID.

methods.name: validateMacAddress
methods.description: Validates a MAC address string against a regex pattern.

methods.name: validateMacWrapper
methods.description: Validates MAC address input based on the selected device type, enabling or disabling the submit button accordingly.

methods.name: parseDevice
methods.description: Parses a device string to extract ID, name, and MAC address.

methods.name: btUpdateAdded
methods.description: Updates the UI with information about a newly added Bluetooth device.

methods.name: parsePhy
methods.description: Parses a PHY string to extract ID, name, and devices.

methods.name: btParsePhys
methods.description: Parses a string containing PHY information into a dictionary mapping PHY names to IDs.

methods.name: btUpdateDeviceList
methods.description: Updates the Bluetooth device list UI with current devices, returning the count.

methods.name: addMouseListeners
methods.description: Adds mousedown, mouseup, and mouseout event listeners to a button for hold detection.

methods.name: createControlPanelButton
methods.description: Creates a control panel button with specified title, icon, and event listener.

methods.name: positionModal
methods.description: Positions a modal dialog relative to a button.

methods.name: createModalButton
methods.description: Creates a modal toggle button with drag-and-drop positioning and show/hide functionality.

methods.name: cmdConsole
methods.description: Initializes a command console interface with input and output elements, supporting command callbacks.
